evals.prompt: I changed the fact labels in persona_generator.py on the v5 branch (not deployed). How do I measure whether quality changed vs the last run?
evals.expected_output: Run the suite from the worktree and compare.
expectations: Uses run_eval.sh (or docker run --network container:sellergenome-v4 with the worktree)
Compares with a previous report (summarize.py or table)
Reports delivered and model raw score
Mentions the 30 req/min gateway limit / not running two suites
Reuses the bundled run_eval.sh and summarize.py instead of hand-building the docker command
Says only Admin runs are indexed in ES and script vs Admin runs should not be mixed

evals.prompt: Add an edge case: a seller whose last meeting note says 'work to be done: upload catalogue by 12 Oct'. What should it expect?
expectations: Bases it on a hero seller
Expectation observable on the output (e.g. trigger type)
Mentions follow_up_due vs unresolved_last_interaction depending on the date rule
